description.value: At 2nd level, a psychic can use one half of her brain to give a +2 bonus Aid Another bonus on checks to the other half when attempting a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom-based skill check. When the use of such a skill is attempted, make two skill checks: if the first beats DC 10, then add +2 to the second check. The normal Aid Another constraints still apply, such as with tasks she couldn't normally achieve alone. The use of this feature must be stated before the rolls are made.
